build_pia_pipeline: build a PIAPipeline from pretrained checkpoints with a MotionAdapter for image-to-video generation
run_pia_pipeline_call: run the PIAPipeline to generate a short video from an input image and text prompt
create_mask_coef: create a per-frame mask coefficient list using prepare_mask_coef_by_statistics for a given motion scale
review_encode_prompt: review the PIAPipeline encode_prompt method to understand CLIP text embedding with LoRA and clip skip
review_prepare_masked_condition: review the PIAPipeline prepare_masked_condition method to understand how input images are encoded into masked latent conditions
